classification.difficultyReason: Part a is a direct chord product with an x+1 expression. Part b needs the whole secant written as 3+(x+1) before the secant product rule, then a linear solve.

answer.worked:
Intersecting chords have equal products of their intercepts.
$$\begin{align*}4(x+1)&=3\times8\\4x+4&=24\\4x&=20\\x&=5\end{align*}$$

The products of the external and entire secant lengths are equal.
$$\begin{align*}3(3+x+1)&=2(2+7)\\3(x+4)&=18\\3x+12&=18\\3x&=6\\x&=2\end{align*}$$
